findings.title: Worksheet choice leaks into the next workbook
findings.why_it_matters: After choosing a source worksheet, a later multi-sheet destination template can open with that same sheet name already selected. If the user proceeds without making a fresh template choice, headers come from the coincidentally named sheet in the template. This defeats the template's independent worksheet choice and can replace the output mapping with unintended headers.
evidence: src/ui/Workspace.tsx:324: <button onClick={() => { session.cancelWorksheetSelection(); setWorksheet(""); }}>Cancel worksheet selection</button>
src/ui/Workspace.tsx:425: void session.upload(file, delimiter, { template: true });
docs/decisions/excel-fidelity.md:70: Templates have independent sheet selection and import names/order only.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear the local worksheet choice whenever a new file is submitted or a new worksheet list is presented, including destination templates. Preserve automatic reuse only through the explicit saved-workflow worksheet sent to the session. Add a UI check that choosing a source sheet called Orders does not preselect Orders in a subsequent multi-sheet template.
